text:
Harper (People Ops): Hi all 1 1 Dropping a short summary of the live all-hands Q&A about mid-cycle merits, equity, and benefits. Quick thread for follow-ups.

Liam: Do merit increases happen only at the formal cycle or is there room for ad-hoc increases for retention cases?

Denise (Finance): We rarely do ad-hoc base increases outside the cycle. Exceptions exist for clear retention risk or mispricing; those go through a fast-track approval (People Ops + Finance + Manager). Use comp-requests@redwood.com with justification.

Ravi (Eng): Equity question: if someone gets promoted mid-cycle, will their refresh grant be recalculated or just pro-rated?

Harper (People Ops): Promotions completed before the grant cutoff get a pro-rata refresh. If promo crosses the cutoff, the person will be eligible next cycle. Exact cutoff date posted in the toolkit.

Carmen: Any change to benefits enrollment windows? Heard about a "flex benefits" pilot.

Tess (CEO): Good callout 1 Weve launched a small flexible benefits pilot (wellness stipend + mental health top-up) for Q2. Enrollment is opt-in via benefits portal; HR will email eligible people next week.

Liam: Contractors any comp floor or equity exceptions? Some of our long-term contractors asked about equity.

Harper (People Ops): Contractors are not eligible for equity grants by policy, but long-term contractor conversions to full-time are prioritized and may include one-time equity adjustments on hire. Managers: flag at conversion.

people-ops-bot: Reference docs: https://redwood.internal/hr/comp-fasttrack and https://redwood.internal/hr/flex-benefits-pilot.

Harper (People Ops): If you need private follow-up, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com. We'll post a short FAQ and the fast-track form by EOD Friday.
